ثَوْلٌ A number, or collection, or swarm, of bees: (As, T, S, M, K:) or simply bees: (IAar, Th, T:) a word having no proper sing.; (As, T, S, M, K;) and of the fem. gender: (M:) or the male bee; (M, K;) thus Lth explains it; but the right explanation is the first, that of As. (T.) ―
-b2- And A company of men. (Ibn-'Abbád, TA.) ―
-b3- Also The kind of trees called حَمْض. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
